method: Static inspection, disassembly, managed IL/resource inspection and isolated data decoding. Samples and package lifecycle hooks were not run. Original pool labels and ML verdicts were not treated as truth.
policy: Actual UPX checksum validation failure plus detected UPX packing is hostile as explicitly requested by the user. Missing tools, timeout, I/O, size limits and generic refusal remain recovery diagnostics.
limitations: Installed atomscan/cleave executables were not replaced; final scans use rebuilt sibling target/release binaries.
ML bundle remains v18 with newer v21 feature-extractor warnings; rules and human review are the basis of this triage.
Unresolved protected native files are retained in purgatory. Individual narrow chains are not padded to a three-hostile-label quota.

samples.evidence: Decoded the UTF16 document. Its onload path moves the window offscreen, fetches through ServerXMLHTTP, and evaluates responseText. Fixed extension-assisted HTML identification to inspect decoded text.
samples.limitations: No remote endpoint was contacted.

samples.evidence: Extracted app.pak gzip resource and dumped all 17 managed methods. Loopback HTTP server validates host/site/token, restricts file targets, stores a DPAPI-protected local key and restarts its own process. Exact-hash earlier reviews corroborate the bundled UI inspection.

samples.identity: Native browser-profile enumerator with concealed strings
samples.evidence: Disassembled the Chrome User Data cross-reference at 0x140043280. It builds paths for Chrome, Edge, Brave and Opera; nearby literal constructors use XOR and a shared decoder. Followed several constructors and their crypto helper.
samples.limitations: Credentials, decryption and an exfiltration sink were not sufficiently resolved. No stealer verdict inferred from the filename; this remains a coverage limitation.

samples.evidence: Isolated string-table decoder functions and reconstructed the embedded ZIP from JavaScript plus 11 hidden input fields. The displayed password opens a disk image carrying an LNK, renamed command processor, CMD, obfuscated WSF and registry payload data. CMD copies/renames wscript and reg, imports the registry data and launches WSF. Added an original-carrier smuggling composite.
samples.limitations: Some embedded registry/Base64 and WSF content is malformed or padded; full runtime success is not asserted.

samples.evidence: Read the full HTA: concealed/minimized window settings, empty script/body. Existing suspicious empty-stealth-shell observation is accurate.

samples.identity: Disk image carrying document-LNK and script loaders

Repaired a misleading Office-macro label on generic script download behavior.

samples.evidence: Disassembled 16-bit body: INT21 find-first/next for COM, read original three entry bytes, rewrite entry displacement using old EOF, append own body, restore host entry and jump. Added address-independent operation-sequence detection and search/open composite.
